// matmul compute, generated by kohakutt.dsl.metal.
// Change the program's model, not this file.
#include <cstdint>

#include "api/compute/common.h"
#include "api/compute/compute_kernel_api.h"
#include "api/compute/tile_move_copy.h"
#include "api/compute/matmul.h"

// Common arguments: w_nk, nt, ntot, per_group, kc, w_pages, mt, kt, a_pages, groups.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr uint32_t cb_a = 0, cb_w = 1, cb_out = 16;
    const uint32_t w_nk = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t nt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t ntot = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t per_group = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t kc = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t w_pages = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(5);
    const uint32_t mt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(6);
    const uint32_t kt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(7);
    const uint32_t a_pages = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(8);
    const uint32_t groups = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(9);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t n0 = (core / per_group) * nt;
    const uint32_t cols = nt < (ntot - n0) ? nt : ntot - n0;
    const uint32_t place = core % per_group;
    const uint32_t m0 = (mt * place) / per_group;
    const uint32_t rows = ((mt * (place + 1)) / per_group) - m0;
    if (core >= groups * per_group) {
        return;
    }
    compute_kernel_hw_startup(cb_a, cb_w, cb_out);
    matmul_block_init(cb_a, cb_w, w_nk, cols, 1, kc);
    cb_wait_front(cb_w, w_pages);
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {
        cb_reserve_back(cb_out, nt);
        tile_regs_acquire();
        for (uint32_t k0 = 0; k0 < kt; k0 += kc) {
            const uint32_t count = (kt - k0) < kc ? kt - k0 : kc;
            cb_wait_front(cb_a, a_pages);
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
                matmul_block(cb_a, cb_w, k, (k0 + k) * cols, 0, w_nk, cols, 1, kc);
            }
            cb_pop_front(cb_a, a_pages);
        }
        tile_regs_commit();
        tile_regs_wait();
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
            pack_tile(j, cb_out);
        }
        tile_regs_release();
        cb_push_back(cb_out, nt);
    }
    cb_pop_front(cb_w, w_pages);
}
